$comment: Findings deferred on purpose. Each entry needs the finding id from check-report.json, a reason, a reference (REC record, waiver or pull request) and a review_by date. CI fails on any finding not listed here.

issues.reason: Pre-existing: print templates use CMYK builds for neutral and semantic colours that B02 §5.1.1 does not define (B02 gives CMYK only for the four brand colours). Needs an Approver decision: add CMYK builds for those colours to B02, or remove them from print templates.
issues.reference: REC-A04-009 U-01. Approver approved adding CMYK builds for neutral and status colours to B02 on 2026-11-27; this entry is removed when that B02 release lands.
